findings.title: Account UI error message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the account-ui bundle was changed from i18next placeholders ({{0}}, {{1}}, {{2}}) to Java MessageFormat choice syntax ({0} and {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}). Every other interpolated string in this file uses {{name}} / {{0}}. The account UI does not evaluate Java ChoiceFormat, so when a multivalued attribute fails size validation the user sees the raw pattern, including literal {0}/{1}/{2} and the choice clause, instead of the attribute name and limits. The previous value(s) wording had no HTML and did not need this change for the sanitizer.

findings.title: Admin UI error message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the admin-ui bundle was changed from {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} to Java MessageFormat, including {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}. This file is loaded by the React admin console (i18next-style {{ }} interpolation), not by java.text.MessageFormat. The choice pattern will be shown literally and the attribute name, minimum, and maximum will not be substituted. The Java choice string belongs only in the server theme bundles (themes/.../admin and login messages_en.properties), which were updated separately.

findings.title: Lithuanian account totpStep1 replaced with Italian
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle was replaced with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian, not Lithuanian. The previous Lithuanian sentence (with the FreeOTP/Google Play links) was removed to satisfy the HTML check, but the replacement is the wrong language, so Lithuanian users are instructed in Italian during OTP setup.

findings.title: Lithuanian login totpStep1 replaced with Italian
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian login bundle was replaced with the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". The English source is "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:"; other locales in this PR were actually translated. Lithuanian login users will see Italian text on the OTP setup step.

findings.title: zh_CN totpStep1 is Traditional Chinese
findings.body: totpStep1 in messages_zh_CN.properties was set to "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", which is Traditional Chinese (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). This file is Simplified Chinese (zh_CN); the rest of the bundle uses simplified characters. zh_CN users will see a Traditional script string on the account OTP setup step.

findings.title: Choice-format strip hides HTML from the sanitizer
findings.body: For keys starting with linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit and for error-invalid-multivalued-size, normalizeValue deletes every {n,choice,...} substring with the regex \{[0-9]+,choice,[^}]*} before the HTML policy runs. [^}]* matches arbitrary markup, so a translation can put tags or script inside the choice subformat and the verifier will replace that whole subformat with "..." and then compare a string that no longer contains the HTML. Those keys are formatted with java.text.MessageFormat and the chosen alternative is inserted into login, admin, and email messages — including HTML email bodies — so this bypasses the check this PR adds. Strip or neutralize only the choice operator "<", or run the sanitizer on the choice alternatives before discarding them.

findings.title: Diff highlighter throws when prefix and suffix overlap
findings.body: When sanitized text differs from the message, the code walks a common prefix (start) and a common suffix (end) and then calls value.substring(start, value.length() - end) and the same on sanitized. If the prefix and suffix overlap — start > length - end — String.substring throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. That happens for ordinary edits, for example value "hello" versus sanitized "helo" (one repeated character removed): start=3 and end=2, and sanitized.substring(3, 2) throws. The exception escapes the forEachRemaining lambda, so verify() aborts without recording the "Illegal HTML" diagnostic and without checking the remaining keys of that file. PropertyResourceBundle key order is undefined, so a later illegal entry in the same file may never be reported.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message omits key and file
findings.body: When a translation anchor does not exactly match the English tag, the verifier only records "Didn't find anchor tag " plus the tag text. Unlike the illegal-HTML message, this omits the message key and the properties file. The Maven plugin reports that string as the build failure, so a CI failure cannot be traced to a key without re-running the check by hand.
